describe: Landing / welcome hero on an illustrated futuristic pastel city plaza: neon glass towers left and right, a glowing purple swirl portal behind the characters, a reflective lilac floor with light rings and curved light roads, and planets plus a ringed planet in a soft blue starry sky. Not flat - rich painted scenery that must be inpainted where UI is removed.
charNote: One combined box: the curly-haired boy in a blue jacket and jeans holding hands with Nova, the white-and-blue robot. Top 350 clears the boy's topmost hair wisp (measured at y=356); left 476 clears his left sneaker (x=487) and hair (x=490); right 872 clears Nova's outstretched right hand (x=866); bottom 768 sits just under both pairs of shoes (lowest sole y=758) and above the bright floor light ring that starts near y=770, so the glowing platform stays in the backdrop. The speech-bubble tail drops through the top of the box down to Nova's antenna ball, so the erase rectangle wipes that connector (stopping at the ball top, y=383).
